integrity: Analytic proof and independent finite checker provided; finite samples are consistency tests, not a substitute for all-order proofs. No external independent audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: Real canonical one-dimensional BV inputs with endpoint traces; Lebesgue L1 error; normalized left Riemann–Liouville integral only.
Large-order localization is proved asymptotically, not an explicit elementary closed form for each finite order.
Originality subject to independent priority check, particularly inaccessible early weighted Hardy literature.
title: Sharp integrated BV error of normalized fractional integration and its logarithmic jump retreat
